search_text: published ZDI-12-057 ZDI-CAN-1548 (Pwn2Own) Adobe Flash Player NetStream addBytes Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2012-04-09 9.0 AV:N/AC:L/Au:N/C:P/I:P/A:C ['Adobe'] ['Flash Player'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Adobe Flash Player. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the way Flash Player handles the update of a NetStream object via the appendBytes method which can lead to a use-after-free condition when the function returns. This can result in remote code execution under the context of the current process. http://www.adobe.com/support/security/bulletins/apsb12-07.html ['2012-03-12 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2012-04-09 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] VUPEN Vulnerability Research Team http://www.vupen.com https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-12-057/
title: (Pwn2Own) Adobe Flash Player NetStream addBytes Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Adobe Flash Player. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the way Flash Player handles the update of a NetStream object via the appendBytes method which can lead to a use-after-free condition when the function returns. This can result in remote code execution under the context of the current process.
